prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D cartoon top-down 3/4 liquid VFX sprites for Trashketeers. Thick dark outlines, two-tone cel shading, luminous saturated highlights; no pixel art, no photo, no text, no labels, no frames. Clean evenly spaced grid on flat solid #FF00FF, all particles contained inside their own cell with 48px safe margins. Keep consistent center anchor and coherent evolution of effect. 1536x1024 sheet, 3 columns 2 rows, six successive explosion frames in reading order: 1 compact amber beer impact with white foam, 2 expanding crown, 3 large burst with flying droplets, 4 outward dispersed droplets and foam, 5 smaller falling droplets, 6 last tiny fading droplets. No container, no bottle, no boss.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D cartoon liquid projectile sprite sheet 1536x1024, 3 columns 2 rows of equal square cells. Genuinely transparent background with preserved alpha and no magenta. Top row: amber beer droplet bullet small medium large (diameter 24%,38%,52% of each cell), teardrop points toward upper right. Bottom row: green-yellow vomit/slime bullet small medium large, same sizes and orientation. Semi-transparent liquid interiors with opaque dark contour and small bright white highlight. Thick readable 2D cartoon contours, two-tone soft cel shading. One isolated drop per cell, all six centered; no trail, no text, no ground shadow, no extra particles.
